attempts.summary: Deployed a Python inventory web app on node2 and node3 (systemd-managed, listening on :8080, serving /inventory and /healthz), and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on :80 with an upstream round-robin pool across both backends. Verified end-to-end distribution, then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot IDs and health, rebooted each node individually, polled until it came back, confirmed a changed boot ID, and verified service/cluster recovery (nginx active + LB round-robin restored on node1; inventory-app active + healthz OK on node2/node3) before moving to the next node.
